free_tier.stated: No free storage allowance stated as a byte figure on the storage page; instead 'Stream applies fair-usage limits to storage, bandwidth, and API calls on every Chat plan' with overage rates once exceeded.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Metered past the fair-use allowance. 'You only start to pay extra for storage and bandwidth after you exceed these fair usage limits'. Attachments are served from Stream's CDN but are tied to channel membership/auth.

tooling: Stream-chat SDKs (JS/React/Node/Python); server-side client can upload attachments to a channel. No bulk/opaque-object API. Attachment shape is image/file on a message.
chaining: Fails the multiplication test: fair-use storage caps plus per-GB overage means more accounts is the only lever, and each account is a SaaS tenant with its own MAU billing.
limits_note: Fair-usage storage + bandwidth ceiling; user-configurable retention policies exist expressly to REDUCE storage, which signals storage is the cost centre. Attachment size caps apply. Overage is billed per GB.
